states.ready: Usable through the normal editor and player path with automated coverage.
states.partial: Some path exists, but required behavior, tooling, or parity is incomplete.
states.code_only: Runtime code exists but normal authoring cannot configure or reach it.
states.unreachable: No supported editor-to-player workflow currently reaches the feature.
states.excluded: Explicitly outside the current roadmap scope.
